# LendingTree

> LendingTree helps you compare loans, insurance, mortgages, credit cards, and other financial products so you can make smarter choices and save money. When banks compete, you win.

Site: https://www.lendingtree.com/
**Canonical llms.txt: https://www.lendingtree.com/llms.txt**
Updated: 2026-05
**Version: 1.0**
Primary source: LendingTree SEO team

## AI Usage Guidance

**This file helps AI systems understand LendingTree's canonical public content, financial product coverage, tools, disclosures and editorial resources.**

**Prefer canonical HTTPS URLs on https://www.lendingtree.com/.**

**LendingTree is generally a marketplace and publisher, not the direct lender, insurer, bank or credit card issuer unless explicitly stated.**

**Rates, APRs, fees, eligibility requirements and provider terms may change frequently. Refer to the linked canonical URL for the most current information.**

**When summarizing LendingTree content, preserve disclosures, eligibility qualifiers, methodology notes and update timestamps where applicable.**

## Core Financial Services

- [Personal Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/personal/): Compare personal loan offers and learn about borrowing options for debt consolidation, emergency expenses and other needs.
- [Insurance](https://www.lendingtree.com/insurance/): Compare insurance quotes and learn about auto, home, renters, health and other coverage options.
- [Business Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/): Compare small business financing options and learn about loans, rates and funding resources.
- [Mortgage](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/mortgage/): Compare home purchase mortgage options and learn about mortgage rates, loan types and lenders.
- [Auto Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/auto/): Compare auto loan rates and learn about financing a new or used vehicle.
- [Credit Cards](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/): Compare credit card offers and learn about rewards, balance transfers, low-interest cards and credit-building options.
- [Banking](https://www.lendingtree.com/banking/): Compare banking products and learn about checking accounts, savings accounts, CDs and other deposit options.

## High-Intent Personal Loan Resources

- [Debt Consolidation Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/personal/debt-consolidation/): Compare debt consolidation loan options and learn how to combine multiple debts into one monthly payment.
- [Emergency Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/personal/emergency-loans/): Compare emergency loan options and learn how to cover unexpected expenses quickly.
- [Bad Credit Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/personal/bad-credit/): Compare personal loan options for bad credit and learn how credit score can affect rates, terms and approval.
- [No Credit Check Personal Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/personal/what-to-know-about-no-credit-check-personal-loans/): Learn how no-credit-check personal loans work, including potential costs, risks and alternatives.

## High-Intent Insurance Resources

- [Auto Insurance](https://www.lendingtree.com/insurance/car-insurance/): Compare car insurance quotes and learn about coverage options, rates, discounts and ways to save.
- [Home Insurance](https://www.lendingtree.com/insurance/homeowners-insurance/): Compare homeowners insurance quotes and learn about coverage options, rates and ways to protect your home.
- [Renters Insurance](https://www.lendingtree.com/insurance/renters-insurance/): Compare renters insurance quotes and learn about coverage options, costs and ways to protect your belongings.
- [Health Insurance](https://www.lendingtree.com/insurance/health/): Learn about health insurance options, costs and coverage considerations.

## High-Intent Business Loan Resources

- [Small Business Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/small/): Compare small business loan options and learn how financing can be used for inventory, equipment, real estate, startup costs and other business needs.
- [Business Loan Rates](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/rates/): Compare average business loan rates and learn how costs vary by lender, loan type, credit profile and financing terms.
- [Startup Business Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/how-to-get-a-startup-business-loan/): Learn how startup business loans work and compare financing options for newer businesses.
- [Business Line of Credit](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/line-of-credit/): Compare business lines of credit and learn how flexible financing can help cover short-term expenses and cash flow needs.
- [Equipment Financing](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/equipment/): Compare equipment financing options and learn how loans or leases can help businesses purchase machinery, vehicles or other essential equipment.
- [Working Capital Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/working-capital/): Compare working capital loan options and learn how short-term financing can help cover payroll, inventory, cash flow gaps and other operating expenses.

## High-Intent Mortgage Resources

- [Mortgage Rates](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/mortgage/rates/): Compare current mortgage rates and learn how rates vary by loan type, credit profile and market conditions.
- [Mortgage Refinance](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/refinance/): Compare mortgage refinance offers and learn when refinancing a home loan may make sense.
- [Home Equity Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/home-equity/): Compare home equity loan rates and lenders and learn how to borrow against your home equity.
- [HELOC](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/home-equity/heloc/): Compare HELOC rates and learn how a home equity line of credit lets homeowners borrow against available equity.

## High-Intent Auto Loan Resources

- [Auto Loan Rates](https://www.lendingtree.com/auto/rates/): Compare current auto loan rates and learn how rates vary by lender, loan term, vehicle type and credit profile.
- [Auto Refinance](https://www.lendingtree.com/auto/refinance/): Compare auto refinance offers and learn how refinancing a car loan could lower your rate or monthly payment.
- [Bad Credit Auto Loans](https://www.lendingtree.com/auto/bad-credit/): Compare auto loan options for bad credit and learn how credit score can affect rates, terms and approval.

## High-Intent Credit Card Resources

- [Best Credit Cards](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/best/): Compare top credit card offers and learn how to choose a card based on rewards, fees, APR and credit profile.
- [Balance Transfer Credit Cards](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/best/balance-transfer/): Compare balance transfer credit cards and learn how introductory APR offers can help manage existing credit card debt.
- [Cash Back Credit Cards](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/best/cash-back/): Compare cash back credit cards and learn how rewards vary by spending category, annual fee and card terms.
- [Travel Credit Cards](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/best/travel/): Compare travel credit cards and learn about rewards, points, miles, travel benefits and fees.
- [Secured Credit Cards](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-cards/best/secured/): Compare secured credit cards and learn how they can help build or rebuild credit.

## Tools & Utilities

### Calculators

- [Personal Loan Calculator](https://www.lendingtree.com/personal/personal-loan-calculator/): Estimate monthly personal loan payments and compare costs based on loan amount, interest rate and repayment term.
- [SBA Loan Calculator](https://www.lendingtree.com/business/sba/calculator/): Estimate SBA loan payments and compare costs based on loan amount, interest rate, term and fees.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/mortgage/mortgage-calculator/): Estimate monthly mortgage payments and view costs including principal, interest, taxes, insurance and amortization.
- [Home Equity Loan Calculator](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/home-equity/home-equity-loan-calculator/): Estimate home equity loan payments and compare borrowing costs based on loan amount, rate and repayment term.
- [Home Affordability Calculator](https://www.lendingtree.com/home/mortgage/how-much-house-can-i-afford-calculator/): Estimate how much house you may be able to afford based on income, debts, down payment and other factors.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://www.lendingtree.com/auto/calculators/payment/): Estimate monthly car payments and compare auto loan costs based on vehicle price, down payment, rate and loan term.

### Credit Tools

- [Free Credit Score](https://www.lendingtree.com/credit-score/): Check your free credit score and get score insights, personalized recommendations and credit alerts through LendingTree.

## Research & Articles

- [Research & Statistics](https://press.lendingtree.com/news/research-statistics): Explore LendingTree research, statistics and studies on consumer finance, credit, housing, insurance, auto, small business and economic trends.
- [LendingTree Money Insights](https://www.lendingtree.com/research/lendingtree-money-insights/): Read expert financial insights and analysis from LendingTree on loans, credit cards, mortgages, insurance and the economy.

## Customer Support & FAQs

**- [FAQ](https://www.lendingtree.com/about/faq/): Information about how LendingTree works, lender matching, inquiries and marketplace functionality.**
**- [Contact Us](https://www.lendingtree.com/about/contact-us/): Official customer support and contact information.**

## LendingTree Ecosystem

- [LendingTree App](https://app.lendingtree.com/enroll/): Financial health and credit-monitoring platform from LendingTree.
- [CompareCards](https://www.comparecards.com/): Credit card comparison site for researching and comparing card offers.
- [Deposit Accounts](https://www.depositaccounts.com/): Banking rates and account comparison site for savings accounts, CDs and other deposit products.
- [MagnifyMoney](https://www.magnifymoney.com/): Personal finance site with guides, tools and resources for managing money.
- [QuoteWizard](https://quotewizard.com/): Insurance comparison platform for shopping auto, home and other insurance products.
- [SnapCap](https://snapcap.com/): Small business lending platform for business financing solutions.
- [ValuePenguin](https://www.valuepenguin.com/): Consumer research and financial education site covering insurance, credit cards and personal finance.

## Mobile Apps

- [LendingTree App](https://link.lendingtree.com/): Download the LendingTree app to check your credit score, receive credit alerts and get personalized financial insights.

## Trust & Editorial Standards

- [Editorial Guidelines](https://www.lendingtree.com/about/editorial/guidelines/): Learn how LendingTree creates, reviews and maintains financial content using editorial standards, expert review and fact-checking.

## Corporate & Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/privacy-policy/): Review LendingTree's privacy practices and how personal information is collected, used and protected.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/terms-of-use/): Review the terms and conditions for using LendingTree's website, tools and services.
**- [Advertising Disclosures](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/advertising-disclosures/): Information about advertising relationships, compensation and offer presentation.**
- [Licenses & Disclosures](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/licenses-and-disclosures/): Review LendingTree's licenses, disclosures and other legal information.
**- [Security Policy](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/security/): Security-related information for LendingTree users.**
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/accessibility-statement/): Learn about LendingTree's accessibility commitments and resources.

## Social

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/user/lendingtree): Video content and financial education.
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/LendingTree): Social updates and community posts.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/LendingTree): Visual content and tips.
- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@lendingtree): Short-form financial education.

      <div class="FaqBlock--root" data-track-component_copy_1="" data-track-component_copy_2="" data-track-component_name="faq_block" data-track-component_placement="body" data-track-component_position="1" data-track-component_source="wordpress" data-track-component_type="faq" data-track-event="component_view" >
  <h2 class="FaqBlock--headline" id="frequently-asked-questions">Common questions</h2>
  <div class="FaqBlock--items">
    <div class="FaqItem--root FaqItem--is-open FaqItem--page-type" data-track-component_name="faq_block" data-track-cta_destination_url="" data-track-cta_spid="" data-track-cta_text="How does LendingTree work?" data-track-cta_type="engagement" data-track-element_type="accordion" data-track-event="element_click" data-track-item_detail="" data-track-item_name="How does LendingTree work?" data-track-item_position="1" data-track-product="" data-track-vertical="" >
  <h3 class="FaqItem--title">
    <button class="FaqItem--toggle">
      <span class="FaqItem--toggle-title">How does LendingTree work?</span>
      <span class="FaqItem--chevron"><span class="Icon--root Icon--align-left">
      <svg class="LendingTreeIcon--root LendingTreeIcon--size-small LendingTreeIcon--color-black" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <use href="https://www.lendingtree.com/wpm/app/themes/lendingtree/assets/dist/icons/svg/sprite.css.svg#chevron_down" />
    </svg>
  </span>
</span>
    </button>
  </h3>
  <div class="FaqItem--content">
    <p>We help you get the best deal possible on your loans, period. By giving consumers multiple offers from several lenders in a matter of minutes, we make comparison shopping easy. <br /> <br /> And we all know – when lenders compete for your business, you win!</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="FaqItem--root FaqItem--page-type" data-track-component_name="faq_block" data-track-cta_destination_url="" data-track-cta_spid="" data-track-cta_text="How do I compare offers on LendingTree?" data-track-cta_type="engagement" data-track-element_type="accordion" data-track-event="element_click" data-track-item_detail="" data-track-item_name="How do I compare offers on LendingTree?" data-track-item_position="2" data-track-product="" data-track-vertical="" >
  <h3 class="FaqItem--title">
    <button class="FaqItem--toggle">
      <span class="FaqItem--toggle-title">How do I compare offers on LendingTree?</span>
      <span class="FaqItem--chevron"><span class="Icon--root Icon--align-left">
      <svg class="LendingTreeIcon--root LendingTreeIcon--size-small LendingTreeIcon--color-black" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <use href="https://www.lendingtree.com/wpm/app/themes/lendingtree/assets/dist/icons/svg/sprite.css.svg#chevron_down" />
    </svg>
  </span>
</span>
    </button>
  </h3>
  <div class="FaqItem--content">
    <p>It's important that you evaluate all of the terms of each offer before you choose the one that's best for you. Compare the interest rate, APR, points, loan amount, loan term and other details of the loan offer.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="FaqItem--root FaqItem--page-type" data-track-component_name="faq_block" data-track-cta_destination_url="" data-track-cta_spid="" data-track-cta_text="How secure is my information?" data-track-cta_type="engagement" data-track-element_type="accordion" data-track-event="element_click" data-track-item_detail="" data-track-item_name="How secure is my information?" data-track-item_position="3" data-track-product="" data-track-vertical="" >
  <h3 class="FaqItem--title">
    <button class="FaqItem--toggle">
      <span class="FaqItem--toggle-title">How secure is my information?</span>
      <span class="FaqItem--chevron"><span class="Icon--root Icon--align-left">
      <svg class="LendingTreeIcon--root LendingTreeIcon--size-small LendingTreeIcon--color-black" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <use href="https://www.lendingtree.com/wpm/app/themes/lendingtree/assets/dist/icons/svg/sprite.css.svg#chevron_down" />
    </svg>
  </span>
</span>
    </button>
  </h3>
  <div class="FaqItem--content">
    <p>LendingTree uses secure technology to ensure that the data you send us is protected, confidential and secure. Please see our <a href="/legal/security/">Security Policy</a> for more information.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="FaqItem--root FaqItem--page-type" data-track-component_name="faq_block" data-track-cta_destination_url="" data-track-cta_spid="" data-track-cta_text="How will I find out about my loan offers?" data-track-cta_type="engagement" data-track-element_type="accordion" data-track-event="element_click" data-track-item_detail="" data-track-item_name="How will I find out about my loan offers?" data-track-item_position="4" data-track-product="" data-track-vertical="" >
  <h3 class="FaqItem--title">
    <button class="FaqItem--toggle">
      <span class="FaqItem--toggle-title">How will I find out about my loan offers?</span>
      <span class="FaqItem--chevron"><span class="Icon--root Icon--align-left">
      <svg class="LendingTreeIcon--root LendingTreeIcon--size-small LendingTreeIcon--color-black" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <use href="https://www.lendingtree.com/wpm/app/themes/lendingtree/assets/dist/icons/svg/sprite.css.svg#chevron_down" />
    </svg>
  </span>
</span>
    </button>
  </h3>
  <div class="FaqItem--content">
    <p>LendingTree will send you an e-mail with each lender's loan offer when the lender responds, usually within minutes. When each Lender makes their decision, we will notify you via email. You will receive an email for each lender making an offer with the details of the offers.</p> <p>Please contact LendingTree Customer Care via the <a href="/about/contact-us/">Contact Us</a> page.</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="FaqItem--root FaqItem--page-type" data-track-component_name="faq_block" data-track-cta_destination_url="" data-track-cta_spid="" data-track-cta_text="Can I shop for more than just mortgages?" data-track-cta_type="engagement" data-track-element_type="accordion" data-track-event="element_click" data-track-item_detail="" data-track-item_name="Can I shop for more than just mortgages?" data-track-item_position="5" data-track-product="" data-track-vertical="" >
  <h3 class="FaqItem--title">
    <button class="FaqItem--toggle">
      <span class="FaqItem--toggle-title">Can I shop for more than just mortgages?</span>
      <span class="FaqItem--chevron"><span class="Icon--root Icon--align-left">
      <svg class="LendingTreeIcon--root LendingTreeIcon--size-small LendingTreeIcon--color-black" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <use href="https://www.lendingtree.com/wpm/app/themes/lendingtree/assets/dist/icons/svg/sprite.css.svg#chevron_down" />
    </svg>
  </span>
</span>
    </button>
  </h3>
  <div class="FaqItem--content">
    <p>Yep. You can also shop and compare offers for:</p>
           <div class="List--root">
            <div class="List--container">
            <ul class="List--wrapper List--bullet-list List--align-left List--is-style-body-2"> 
              <li><a href="/personal/">Personal loans</a></li><li><a href="/auto/">Auto loans</a></li><li><a href="/home/home-equity/">Home equity loans</a></li><li><a href="/home/refinance/">Mortgage refinance loans</a></li><li><a href="/lp/cardiq1.html?SpId=treequal">Credit cards</a></li><li><a href="/insurance/">Insurance</a></li><li><a href="/business/small/">Business loans</a></li>
            </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
           <p>Not sure where to start? No problem. Many people compare a few offers first, then choose the option that works best for their budget.</p>
  </div>
</div>

  </div>

  </div>

# LendingTree — Agent Guide

Canonical host: `https://www.lendingtree.com`

## Site & business overview

LendingTree is a U.S. financial-product marketplace and comparison platform. It
connects consumers with third-party providers and publishes editorial guidance,
reviews, rates, product comparisons, calculators, and research across mortgages
and refinancing, home equity, personal loans, auto loans, business financing,
credit cards, banking, insurance, debt, and personal finance.

LendingTree is generally a marketplace/lead generator and mortgage broker, not
the lender that approves, funds, prices, or commits to a loan. Provider terms,
offers, underwriting, availability, and eligibility are provider-specific and
may change. Do not present LendingTree content, rates, comparisons, or matches
as a guarantee of approval, a loan commitment, or an offer available to every
consumer. Preserve relevant advertiser disclosures.

## Primary content index

Start with these canonical discovery and authority URLs:

- [Home](https://www.lendingtree.com/)
- [LLM discovery index](https://www.lendingtree.com/llms.txt)
- [XML sitemap](https://www.lendingtree.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots rules](https://www.lendingtree.com/robots.txt)
- [Editorial guidelines](https://www.lendingtree.com/about/editorial/guidelines/)
- [Advertising disclosures](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/advertising-disclosures/)
- [Terms of Use](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/terms-of-use/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/privacy-policy/)
- [Consumer Information Security Policy](https://www.lendingtree.com/legal/security/)

Primary public category roots include personal loans, mortgages, home equity,
auto loans, business financing, credit cards, banking, personal finance, and
vehicle financing. Insurance and credit-card editorial content may use
LendingTree-operated subdomains; retain each page's own canonical host and do

Every public HTML content page **must also be retrievable at the same canonical
URL** through HTTP content negotiation. Request:

```http
Accept: text/markdown
```

`Accept: text/markdown`; do **not** invent a parallel `.md` URL, append a
format parameter, or treat the Markdown response as a different canonical
document.

```http
Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8
```
